description: This PHP source file defines the Banner class within the Goteo project, specifically in the Goteo\Model\Call namespace. It manages banner data related to call banners, including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, and reordering. The class interacts with database tables, notably 'call_banner' and 'call_banner_lang', and uses related classes like Image and Config.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Represents a call banner, providing methods for retrieving, listing, validating, saving, and reordering banners, with support for multilingual name fields and associated images.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the name fields that are usable for multilingual support.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a single banner by its ID from the database.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all banners associated with a specific call, supporting language variations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of banners for a specific call, similar to getAll but with additional image processing.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the banner's data, ensuring the 'call' field is present.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the banner to the database, handling image upload and updating.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves a banner up in order within a call's list.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves a banner down in order within a call's list.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for inserting a new banner at the end.
